title: Autoswapper Wallet
tagline: Autoswapper wallet powered by 1inch fusion API and EIP 7702 to do swaps as per a session key config
description: Autoswapper wallet powered by 1inch fusion API and EIP 7702 to do swaps as per a session key configuration with a expiry in the delegator for each swap session defined and the funds are sent to the session address doing the swaps from the delegator after it is attached in the authorisation list and we check the session expiry before each swap.
how_its_made:
We use viem which is a typescript interface for ethereum for eip 7702 integration, along with 1inch fusion api, the contracts are powered by the foundry framework using libraries like solady, openzeppelin.

The UI is built using the next JS library and the styling and ux interface is all handled through that
